author: Nelev
body:
## Summary
- `export_conversation_pdf` becomes `export_conversation(format)`. The model passes the format the patient asked for (the tool description and system prompt say how); no code parses the message.
- `csv` and `json` are written from the turns with the standard library. Anything else, including an unknown or missing format, is a PDF rendered from markdown with `markdown-pdf` (raw HTML off).
- The reply is `{status, file, format, requested, turns}`, so the model can say when it fell back to a PDF.
- CSV cells that start with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` get a leading `'` so a spreadsheet does not run them as formulas.
- README export section, CLAUDE.md, the tool eval cases (two new ones for the format argument) and the eval's export stub are updated.

## Notes
- Adds `markdown-pdf`, which brings in PyMuPDF (AGPL). If that matters for how Medas ships, the PDF step can go back to reportlab.
- An exported file still cannot be downloaded; that stays under Known gaps.

## Test plan
- [x] `uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pytest -q` (195 passed)
- [x] Exported a conversation in each format and read the files back
- [x] `python -m dataset.eval.run_tool_eval`: 18/19 cases route correctly, including `spreadsheet` -> csv and `json` -> json. The one miss ("What medications is my sister taking?" calls the search tool, then refuses) is unrelated to export.
